text: Every video must have a proper thumbnail/cover, and its text must hedge exactly like the narration (same qualifiers, no stronger claim than the voiceover makes).
evidence: black-october: Owner: 'Every video needs a proper thumbnail... The cover must hedge exactly like the narration.' | retired: the cover is made by frameflow.cover, whose prompt already requires the narration's hedges

text: Keep a single ending beat after the payoff (one closing question or one practical takeaway, not both stacked); never write a follow call to action, the pipeline's end card adds it.
evidence: black-october: Owner: 'an outro call to action (follow)'. Review: three endings run back to back in the 18s tail after the payoff.

text: Never leave a frame near-empty while the narrator is speaking: every key phrase (stat, rating, quote intro) needs its visual on screen from the first frame and held until the line ends. Check keyframes at each narration cue for blank pages.
evidence: black-october: Scene 5 at 29s faint kicker only during 'rated nine point', Scene 8 blank page at 43s during 'Chainguard's CEO says', cake missing before Scene 6, and Scene 10 sky text appearing early over the wrong line.

text: When revising a script, keep the first draft's voice, jokes and rhythm; fix only what the notes name. In a blind test the owner preferred the first draft over the final revised one.
evidence: black-october: blind A/B on 2026-10-25, Talha chose script-v1 over script (final).
